mapper.select: SELECT /*+ INDEX(b idx_int_binding_task_page) */ COUNT(*) FROM int_sync_binding b WHERE b.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND b.task_id=#{query.taskId} AND b.deleted=FALSE

SELECT /*+ INDEX(b idx_int_binding_task_page) */ b.id,b.tenant_id,b.object_key,b.source_key,b.target_id,b.fields_json,b.last_run_id FROM int_sync_binding b WHERE b.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND b.task_id=#{query.taskId} AND b.id > #{query.afterId} AND b.deleted=FALSE AND b.fields_json LIKE '%"_targets"%' ORDER BY b.id LIMIT #{query.limit} FOR UPDATE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM int_sync_binding WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND task_id=#{taskId}
DELETE FROM int_sync_binding WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND task_id IN (SELECT id FROM int_sync_task WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND adapter=#{adapter})
